items.title: De De Pierce Interview, 1960-01-10
items.q: What about Frankie Dooson, would he? Or would he play mostly in the ensemble?

ctx.x: Who would feature himself much on trombone? A lot of old men, I just can't call names.
What about Frankie Dooson, would he? Or would he play mostly in the ensemble? Frankie, Frankie.
You don't remember Frankie? No, I'm trying to think now. You called him Frankie Dooson. Not Frank, Frank.
